request.subject: UNIT:DINOSAUR:JUGGERNAUT

layers.text: Take off the red neck bands, the grey collar and the red blanket with its cord, so the long neck, back and flanks are bare smooth blue hide with a cream belly and throat. Nothing red is left. Keep the head, eyes, smile, the long neck, legs, tail, pose, proportions, thick black outline and art style exactly the same, on a transparent background.
